# openmetadata_dashboard_data_model (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata dashboard data model by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_dashboard_data_model" "sales" {
  fully_qualified_name = "warehouse.model.sales_model"
}

output "sales_data_model_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_dashboard_data_model.sales.id
}

output "sales_data_model_columns" {
  value = data.openmetadata_dashboard_data_model.sales.columns
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Data model fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Data model UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `columns` (Attributes List) Columns exposed by the data model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))
- `data_model_type` (String) Kind of data model, for example PowerBIDataModel.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Data model name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the dashboard service that owns the data model.
- `sql` (String) SQL query that defines the data model.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

<a id="nestedatt--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Read-Only:

- `data_type` (String) OpenMetadata column data type.
- `description` (String) Markdown description of the column.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable column name.
- `name` (String) Column name.
